---
title: "FAQ"
---

## Why are the slides HTML and not PDF?

HTML slides are searchable, work on any device, can hold live code and be
corrected centrally. If you want a PDF you can export one yourself from any deck
in a few clicks — see the course guide on your course site.

## How do I get into a course site?

Course sites are password-protected. The login is announced to enrolled students
through the course's own channels. There is one shared login per course.

## I am not enrolled — can I see the material?

The course sites are for enrolled students. The [teaching philosophy](philosophy.qmd)
and [infrastructure](infrastructure.qmd) are public here, and openly licensed
material is collected under [Resources](resources.qmd).

## Can I reuse your material?

Yes, within the licenses: content under CC BY-SA 4.0, code under MIT, with
attribution. Some figures come from third parties and are not mine to relicense
— those are marked where they appear.

## What software do the practicals use?

Open, reproducible environments (Python and bioconda tools, pinned with pixi).
Everything needed is specified per course; nothing proprietary is required.

## I found a mistake or a broken link.

Please tell me — see [Contact](contact.qmd). Corrections go live for everyone at
once.
